scope: Local CPU release validation; no full benchmark or Bayesian optimization run
checks: All 11 published benchmark Python sources compile
Both QM8 and QM9 CLI input checks pass on synthetic SMILES/label/XYZ fixtures with nine point features
Row/SMILES mismatches, reordered map rows, duplicate XYZ files, missing files, and path escapes are rejected
All seven nonempty modality combinations complete CPU forward and backward with finite outputs/gradients; multi-branch models select GatedFusion and absent branches receive zero gate weight
Seeded random splits are disjoint and sorted; full-pool retrieval and first-index tie handling pass
XYZ Fortran-style floats and centering pass; truncated and nonfinite coordinates are rejected
limitations: The synthetic input check does not validate the historical full dataset, cleaned QM8 row mapping, or historical reported metrics.
The original model snapshot had concatenation active; selecting its existing gate is an explicit publication adaptation.
Full end-to-end training, plotting/Excel export, CUDA execution, and optional Optuna trials were not run during packaging.
Historical Bayesian optimization provenance and upstream source licensing have not been established.
